example_lines: Right, so what your body is doing right now is not a problem. It's a process. Those are different things, and I need you to feel that difference.
I've done this four hundred times. Every single one was the first time for the person doing it. That's always true. That's always okay.

story_hooks: A newborn she delivered six weeks ago is showing genetic markers that don't match either parent, suggesting either a lab error, undisclosed geneware, or something more troubling â€” and the family has received a visit from a Helix representative asking questions.

She was the midwife for the child of a recently murdered woman, and is now the only person who knows what the mother whispered to her during labor â€” information she isn't sure whether to share with anyone.
